visual_summary: Across all 35 published contact sheets and 9 keyframes, the F3 sequence is coherent and continuous. A wave propagates and returns through the tank, with localized high crests and narrow sparse spray near the side boundary at several times. No gross explosion, crop, abrupt termination, or broad visible escape was observed. This is a visual first-stage review only; it does not establish large runup/inundation, strict containment, sub-DP absence, or numerical precision acceptance.
